calls.thesis: Guest Whitney Tilson (Stansberry Research): speculative — eVTOL leader retraced to $7 (~$6B mkt cap), no revenue/FAA approval yet; unlimited upside, size appropriately. First commercial flights in UAE the catalyst.
calls.bull_case: Buyout for motor/battery tech and engineers by an EV maker or defense contractor if air-taxi story fails.
calls.bear_case: No near-term catalyst; FAA approval 1-2+ years out; could run out of runway if delays persist (he argues cash is fine).
